column3: Close to the Hebrew; בְּרֹגֶז (“the raging”) is rendered “the thunder.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְאוֹרוֹ (“his light”) is rendered “His lightning.”
Close to the Hebrew; “so that all the men of his work may know” is rendered “That all men may know His work.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “of the south” to “the chamber” and “of the north” to “the scattering winds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the breadth of the waters is in constraint” is rendered “the broad waters are frozen.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְשֵׁבֶט (“for a rod”) is rendered “for correction,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “when the earth is still from the south” is rendered “When He quiets the earth by the south wind.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִשְׁחָקִים (“the clouds, skies”) is rendered “the skies.”
Close to the Hebrew; זָהָב (“gold”) is rendered “golden splendor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he does not see any who are wise of heart” is rendered “He shows no partiality to any.”
